corrections: Replaced generic fuselage with sampled DHC Mk.I landplane side contours, hollow rectangular cabin, original door apertures and rear portholes, open radial cowling with nine cylinders, fins and pushrods, two-blade propeller, constant-chord braced wing and rounded fin/rudder.

Authored fixed main gear and tailwheel against the manual ground line; corrected rudder hinge/outline after overlay inspection. Added separated flap/elevator/rudder/aileron surfaces, linked flap/aileron droop, rib detail, selected seams/rivets, step and antenna.

Rebuilt original cockpit layout from manufacturer panel diagram: raised left six-pack, central engine stack and power quadrant, map/radio panel, single throw-over control column, roof trim wheels, flap pump and oil filler. Corrected the old description that placed engine controls overhead.
Wired TAS in mph, geometric altitude, true heading, attitude, VSI, turn rate and normalized engine RPM scaled to 2300; controls, power lever, flap indication and control surfaces follow simulation.
reviewNotes.visual: Personally inspected four final overlays, eight standard views and eleven instrument/detail renders, including missing data, negative altitude, control extremes, overhead and close exterior. Geometry/sightline check and 25 shared/specific instrument tests passed; deterministic candidate is byte-identical.
limitations: The manual drawing has about 3 percent plan span/length inconsistency. Printed dimensions take priority; scan is rigidly rotated and uniformly scaled, never warped. Nominal 9ft tail height uses a sloping ground datum rather than flight-datum bounding height.
The static 9.43-degree tailwheel stance is baked into geometry. Current simulation does not resolve dynamic tailwheel ground pitch; attitude gauge explicitly uses simulation datum.
Cockpit diagram is perspective and undimensioned; scale/depth estimates are approximate. Modern photo is an independent hardware check, not the original panel arrangement.

TAS is not IAS; altitude is geometric feet and heading true. Simulated normalized RPM is scaled to the declared engine RPM, without a separate prop governor. Fuel, manifold pressure, oil, CHT, carb temperature and navigation readings are unavailable and blank/--.
Clean landplane only. Cabin trim, fastening and rib spacing are polygonal approximations, not complete engineering fabrication data. No reference image pixels are embedded.
